desc:
🍼 Welcome to Team Daycare Escape! 🍼
You’ve been trapped in the daycare by Mr. Joe… and he’s not letting you out that easily!
It’s time to team up with your friends, solve chaotic puzzles, and escape together!
But beware — not everything is as it seems... 😈

✨ FEATURES:
🔹 Solve crazy team-based challenges
🔹 Use troll mechanics to prank or sabotage your friends (just for fun 😉)
🔹 Work together… or don’t — the choice is yours
🔹 Unlock new worlds every week! (Bathrooms, Rooftops, Basement & more!)
🔹 Collect funny trails and game-breaking boosts

🔥 NEW CONTENT
We regularly add new levels and themed events — stay tuned!

🛍️ New gamepasses & troll tools added constantly!
